data_section_full_text:
Sample Selection

I hand-collected data about boards and board audit committees from SEC-filed proxy
statements. Initially, I include all U.S. firms listed on the S&P 500 as of March 31, 1992
and 1993, with annual shareholder meetings between July 1, 1991, and June 30, 1993.
I exclude 65 bank and financial institution firm-years and 38 insurance company firmyears. I also delete three firm-years with missing audit committee composition data, and
58 firm-years with missing Compustat or CRSP data. The final sample has 803 firm-year
observations.
